blocks.p: A note on this edition. This is Bunyan’s story, scene for scene, in modern English. Nothing has been added and no episode has been removed. The sentences have been rebuilt for a reader today, while keeping the rhythm Bunyan gave them: the long parallel clauses, the repetitions, the refrain of “Then I saw in my dream.” His poems and songs are kept as rhymed verse. His Bible references stay in the text in brackets, exactly where he placed them; three that were misprinted in the source have been corrected. Dialogue is set as in a modern novel rather than a play script. The long doctrinal conversations keep every argument but lose some repetition. A handful of names whose meaning has worn away over three centuries have been renamed; the full list is at the back. Everything else, from Christian to the Celestial City, is as he wrote it.
